en.html:
I pulled the nearly broken <ruby>wing armor<rt>wings</rt></ruby> upright and flew. The enemy was trying to recover also.

Could I finish it before then?

No. It did not matter if I was too late.

Before or after—<ruby>so long as I killed it<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>!

The necessary part I had heard.

Only execution remained!
